title: Catch duplicate venture slugs and duplicate fixes at push time
problem: Two sessions build the same venture or the same fix. The duplicate check reads open PRs, which cannot see a PR that merged minutes earlier.
evidence: 2 duplicate fix pairs both merged (#6894/#6895, #6962/#6963), 4 pairs closed unmerged, 1 venture name merged twice: prompts/process/reports/2026-10-15-addendum.md, finding 2
change: A check (in platform/ci/ or session_gate.py) that, given a slug or branch, reports `ventures/<slug>` already on origin/main and open or recently merged PRs naming the slug. Call it from land-your-work before opening the PR. Shipped as platform/ci/slug_dupe.py (git-only, no token), linked from land-your-work.md.
metric: Closed-unmerged duplicate PRs and repeated '<slug>: new venture' subjects per two weeks
baseline: 4 closed pairs + 2 merged pairs + 1 repeated name in 2026-10-01..15
